parameter_family.fixed_route: 1040 unique conditional proposals: two momentum routes x six lookbacks x thirteen holds x four premiums=624; other eight existing legal routes fixed lookback3 x thirteen holds x four premiums=416. All explicitly fixed exit/min_hold1/block.
parameter_family.priority: Optuna single-objective net CAGR. Primary ranking: net CAGR descending, absolute MDD ascending, actual closed frequency descending. Original three thresholds remain, feasible subsets and Pareto are diagnostics; long holds are not excluded for low frequency.
parameter_family.always_control: Competing execution-mechanism and risk-state explanation; always is legal only for fixed exit, never opportunity_loss.
parameter_family.early_exit_successor: Separately declared six opportunity routes may investigate opportunity_loss/min_hold/unknown-risk policies after matching same-source FULL equivalence. A mixed always+loss Cartesian grid is rejected before execution.

stop_policy: Declared fixed grid complete is a checkpoint. Assess goal gap, fills, costs, frequency and premium/holding contacts before successor expansion; it is not research closure.
publication_policy: All screening qualifiers and justified strongest frontiers require complete successor FULL. Screening rows have no Candidate identity.

excluded_partial_witnesses.error_message: evaluate_many requires a non-empty tuple of requests
